intro: The Vanilla laundry box turns everyday chores into something seamless. Durable, portable, & designed to fit into any space, it keeps your laundry stored neatly—without disrupting your home’s style.

features.title: Made from durable linen and fabric
features.text: We’ve chosen high-quality linen and fabric that stand up to daily use, ensuring a laundry box that’s as strong as it is stylish.

features.title: Lightweight and easy to carry
features.text: Laundry should never feel like a hassle. Our lightweight design makes it easy to lift, carry, and move around—wherever you need it.

features.title: Foldable for easy storage
features.text: Need extra space? Our laundry box folds flat when not in use, making it perfect for compact homes and small storage areas.

features.title: Fabric drawstring closure keeps clothes secure
features.text: No more messy piles—our secure drawstring top keeps your laundry neatly contained while allowing airflow to prevent musty odours.

features.title: A stylish rectangular design that fits anywhere
features.text: Sleek, modern, and effortlessly elegant, our rectangular shape is designed to fit into your home while making laundry storage look good.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
